name: BABILong
description: Tests reasoning across facts distributed throughout extremely long documents, extending from 1K to over 10 million tokens. Built on the bAbI reasoning tasks embedded within naturalistic long-form text (PG-19 books), BABILong covers 20 diverse reasoning task types. Research showed that popular LLMs effectively utilize only 10–20% of their claimed context window when facts must be integrated across very long spans.
typical_sota_score: ~90% at 1K tokens; drops to ~5–40% at 1M+ tokens depending on task and model
reputation: NeurIPS 2024 Spotlight; revealed that GPT-4 and Gemini 1.5 Pro use only 5–25% of context; widely integrated into long-context evaluation suites for recurrent memory transformers and RAG systems
notes: NeurIPS 2024 Spotlight paper. Key finding: even models claiming 128K+ context windows show dramatic accuracy drops beyond 16K tokens when reasoning requires integrating multiple distributed facts. Supports context lengths up to 10M+ tokens. Benchmarks recurrent architectures (Mamba, RWKV) alongside transformer-based models. From AIRI Moscow.
